steps.title: Verify Manifest & System Permissions
steps.description: Confirmed Camera, Vibration, and Storage permissions alongside standard Material theme registration.

steps.title: Set Up Dynamic Directory Copy for Trained Data
steps.description: Implemented automatic file copy from assets/tessdata/eng.traineddata to context.getFilesDir()/tesseract/tessdata/eng.traineddata if missing or empty.

steps.title: Initialize TessBaseAPI Instance with Logging
steps.description: Initialized com.googlecode.tesseract.android.TessBaseAPI using tessRootDir path (.../files/tesseract) and eng language with verbose status logs.

steps.description: Executed setImage(Bitmap), getUTF8Text(), and explicit clear() invocation on TessBaseAPI after reading frame text.

steps.title: Maintain ZXing Barcode & Multi-Field Product Extraction

steps.title: Optimize Non-Blocking Frame & Gallery Image Processing
steps.description: Ensured camera preview frame processing is lightweight and non-blocking with proper bitmap recycling.

steps.title: Validate Form Auto-Fill & Database Interoperability
steps.description: Guaranteed complete compatibility with existing dialog forms, SQLite inventory helpers, and Java 8 specifications.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
